estimates.assumptions: 2 lemons yield ~120 ml juice total; juice carbs ~5.8 g/100 ml
4 tsp paprika ≈ 8 g; typical ~38 g carbs/100 g with high fiber
2 medium red onions ≈ 220 g finely chopped; ~10 g carbs/100 g with ~1.8 g fiber
16 skinless chicken thighs (1.28 kg total); pure meat has no carbs
1 tbsp (14 g) vegetable oil used for brushing; pure oil has no carbs
300 g full-fat Greek yogurt; typical ~4 g carbs/100 g (mostly lactose)
30 g peeled ginger; ~14 g carbs/100 g with ~2 g fiber
12 g garlic; ~33 g carbs/100 g with low fiber
¾ tsp garam masala ≈ 2 g; typical spice mix ~60 g carbs/100 g
¾ tsp ground cumin ≈ 2 g; ~44 g carbs/100 g with ~10 g fiber
½ tsp chilli powder ≈ 1.5 g; ~56 g carbs/100 g with high fiber
¼ tsp turmeric ≈ 1 g; ~67 g carbs/100 g with ~22 g fiber
